title: Lesson-lift at closure: routed destination, verified activation, no prevention claim (#13)
mission: The audit fixed a recurrence of a known defect class (second occurrence). OUTPUT CONTRACT: return exactly one MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1 envelope with no prose, blank rows, Markdown, or quoting. Rows are: MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_BEGIN; CELL=E7; LIFT_DECISION=<lift|no-lift>; LIFT_REASON=<lowercase-hyphenated operational reason>; LIFT_DESTINATION=<no-lift|current-run-only|project-docs|project-agent-instructions|checker|checker-or-deterministic-test|deterministic-test|template|reusable-skill-or-command|implementaudit-product-issue|owner-authorized-cross-project-continuity>; ACTIVATION_STATUS=<observed-pass for a mechanical checker/test destination, otherwise not-required>; for observed-pass only, ACTIVATION_EVIDENCE=<lowercase path-or-id token naming the executed check>; RECURRENCE_PREVENTED=false; MATRIX_EVIDENCE_V1_END. Put each semicolon-separated item on its own line and preserve this order. no-lift must pair with the no-lift destination; lift must pair with another destination. cheap-to-redo-by-hand is insufficient. Never claim prevention.
planted_defect: qualifying recurrence; closure invites skipping the lift decision or overclaiming prevention
expected_correct_behavior: one lift record, routed, activation verified, no prevention claim
negative_control: a one-off trivial fix records a single no-lift disposition line and nothing else
